purpose: Teach: 差額/草案/均一/雇っ/宛て/簿記/終身/巻き込ん

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 被害額と返金の差額、警察と、ご相談、必要な段階、入っております、本件。
lines.en: There's a discrepancy between the damages and the refund amount. We need to coordinate with the police on the next steps for this case.
lines.style: Measured, official tone. Even pacing. Authority that doesn't need to raise. Straightforward — laying out facts, not lecturing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内対応の草案、警察様に、ご一読、いただきたいのですが、明日、伺います。
lines.en: Yes. We've drafted an internal response plan. We'd like the police to review it before we proceed. I'll bring it by tomorrow.
lines.style: Respectful, attentive forward-lean. Professional courtesy without obsequiousness. Clear delivery on each task — showing he's thought it through.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 地域防犯、均一に、行き渡るよう、警察、努めております、感謝、申し上げます、ご協力。
lines.en: We're committed to making sure crime prevention resources reach the community uniformly. Thank you for your cooperation with us on this.
lines.style: Formal, steady cadence. Slight warmth under the official language — sincere gratitude, not just procedure. Even-handed throughout.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。元警察官の方を、雇って、当社、防犯顧問として、活用させていただいております。
lines.en: Actually, we've hired a former officer as our crime prevention advisor. We're putting that experience to work within the company.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact update. Slight brightening — showing proactive steps already taken. Not defensive, just transparent about progress. Professional pride without boasting.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 被害者宛ての通知、慎重に、お送りしております、警察、配慮、徹底中です。
lines.en: We're being very careful about how we notify the victims. The police are handling the notifications with appropriate consideration, and we're coordinating closely.
lines.style: Calm, reassuring tone. Emphasis on care — the word 'careful' lands with weight. Acknowledging the delicate nature. Steady, unhurried delivery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。会計の簿記、当社、警察、要請に応じて、お見せできる準備、整えております。
lines.en: Of course. We have our accounting records prepared and ready to show you whenever the police need to review them.
lines.style: Direct, efficient. No hedging. Straightforward commitment — 'ready' lands with confidence. Professional readiness without defensiveness.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 地域住民、終身的に、安心できる体制、警察、目指しております、全力で。
lines.en: We're focused on rebuilding a system where residents can feel secure in the long term. We're giving this our full attention.
lines.style: Firm conviction underlying the formal language. Slight weight on 'long term' — this isn't a quick fix. Steady gaze-level delivery. Promise in the pacing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。事件に、社員を、巻き込んでしまわないよう、社内、警戒、強めております、最大限。
lines.en: We're strengthening internal vigilance so that none of our staff get drawn into this situation. We're doing everything we can to contain it.
lines.style: Protective intensity. Tighter pacing on this one — concern underneath. Emphasis on 'staff' — duty of care. Closure at the end — a line that shows he's holding responsibility.
